Navajo Fry Bread 8 Traditional Recipe
§ion;
In the mid 1800's, the U.S. government was dealing with Navajo Indians by commandeering the women and children and marching them to a distant location. On the trip, they were given small allotments of flour, etc. From this, the mothers would mix up a dough and fry it in oil for their children.
There are several versions of this recipe, but this is the one that has worked best for us.
Flour4 Cups Baking Powder4 teaspoons Salt2 teaspoons Milk1¼ Cups
Oil For Frying
Mix together Flour, Baking Powder and Salt. Add Milk and gently knead together. Divide into 2&inch; balls. Flatten each ball into a thin circle. Fry on each side until golden brown.
Eating it plain isn't very pleasurable, so make sure to have Sauces: Honey Butter, Honey, Butter, Jam or something similar on hand. For "Navajo Tacos" make regular taco fillings, but substitute these for the tortillas.
